result.topic_en: Calculations with exponential solutions $e^{\alpha x+\beta y}$ of a linear system: two sums over terms $a_i e^{\beta_i y}$ set to zero, products of the corresponding factors, a combined bracket expression in the $\beta_i$, and auxiliary relations among $\beta_1,\dots,\beta_4$ in terms of $\mu$, $\varrho$ and $\alpha$ (no direct connection to prime numbers is visible).
